title: CORE Tools Store Manifest
description: Consumed by the app launcher to list available apps in the store: icon, screenshots and description are fetched from this repo using each app's media paths. Media paths are rooted at the repo root (e.g. '/apps/<id>/icon/icon.png') and resolved against https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/main.

repo.description: GitHub 'owner/name' slug. Media paths and releases are resolved against this repo.

minLauncherVersion.description: Minimum launcher version (semver, no leading 'v') allowed to use the store and install/update apps. A launcher older than this must be updated before it can install or update anything. Optional; absent means no floor.

id.description: Stable, unique app id. Used as the folder name and the release tag prefix.

name.description: Display name shown in the store.

hidden.description: When true, the launcher omits this app from the store list. Update checks for an already-installed copy still work via releaseTagPrefix. Optional; defaults to false.

tagline.description: Short one-line pitch shown in store listings.

description.description: Longer description shown on the app's detail page.

releaseTagPrefix.description: Prefix of this app's GitHub release tags, e.g. 'core-v' matches tags like core-v1.4.2.

homepage.description: Optional link to the app's own marketing/product page (separate from the store description). Leave empty if none.

changelog.description: Plain-text changelog shown on the app's detail page (not a URL).

icon.description: Path to the app icon/logo, rooted at the repo root, e.g. '/apps/<id>/icon/icon.png'. Resolved as https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/main<path>.

screenshots.description: Repo-root paths to presentation screenshots (3 recommended), e.g. '/apps/<id>/screenshots/1.png'. Same resolution rule as icon.
